openup-inception.name: OpenUP Inception
openup-inception.description: Establish intent, ownership, scope and initial risk, then hold the Lifecycle Objectives milestone against evidence.
openup-inception.author: Aniket Gore

openup-elaboration.name: OpenUP Elaboration
openup-elaboration.description: Establish an executable architecture and retire the highest-exposure risks, then hold the Lifecycle Architecture milestone against evidence.
openup-elaboration.author: Aniket Gore

openup-construction.name: OpenUP Construction Iteration
openup-construction.description: Run one Construction iteration: select ready work risk-first, implement it task by task, verify, re-trace, then hold the iteration gate.
openup-construction.author: Aniket Gore

openup-transition.name: OpenUP Transition
openup-transition.description: Validate deployment, operations, security and acceptance, then hold the Product Release milestone against evidence.
openup-transition.author: Aniket Gore
